_comment: What a deluge costs an Age's instability budget, dial by dial (design 5.2).
Its danger is slow to pay off -- a sea two hours from your door is a threat and not yet a hazard -- so
two of its three dials are cheap. `rate` is how fast the sea climbs while it rains and `downpour` how
much of the time it rains; an Age leaning toward the deluge maxes both early, which is the
near-constant deluge a moderate index should be able to earn.
`height` is how far over its written level the sea is carried, and its steps open one after another
up the index: the first at 16 with the other phenomena, the last just short of the collapse threshold,
so only an Age about to come apart drowns to the build limit. Every number here waits on the tuning
